aarti.tek: Victory to you, divine Puruṣottama; victory to you, Master, divine Puruṣottama. Your glory is boundless; gods and sages serve you.
aarti.pad1: You were declared the best of all the months. When Hari's grace came, you received the form of Kṛṣṇa. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Whoever worshipped you, you gave every happiness; you made his body pure and burnt his sins to ashes. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: When the daughter of the sage Medhāvī came to know your glory, the world honoured her as the virtuous lady named Draupadī. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: The brāhmaṇa Sudeva served you and got back his dead son; he reached Hari's abode, and his fame spread through the world. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: When you showed grace to King Dṛḍhadhanvā, he kept the rites of the vow, its observances and its worship, full of devotion. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Maṇigrīva, a sinful śūdra, offered a lamp; you made his mind pure and gave him Hari's abode. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Those who keep the vow and worship of Puruṣottama with a loving heart, they, says Prabhudāsa, cross the river of worldly existence with ease. ॥7॥
